AnchorSource.description: `ref`: the branch a file comes from when it is not this window's checkout (a branch, or a worktree's branch).

AttachmentAnchor.description: Marks on an image attached to the unsent message (protocol 17): `image` is the composer's ImageRef id. Coordinates as in MediaAnchor. Sent only in the message that carries that image.

Capabilities.description: What the agent behind the server can do (R-M7-15), announced in `hello`; the UI hides a control whose capability is false and the server refuses the matching client message. `modes`: the permission modes it offers (empty: no mode pill). `models`: it lists models and switches model and effort on a running session (the server refuses the `model` message otherwise).

deleteSession.description: the agent deletes a stored session for good (POST /sessions/delete); absent: the Sessions menu offers no delete

dictation.description: speech to text runs on the host (Whisper installed, ready and switched on); absent: not offered. Set by the server, not by the agent.

model3d.description: the server runs with the experimental 3D viewer on (env NOTA_BENE_EXPERIMENTAL_3D=1); absent / false: model files are plain files. Set by the server, not by the agent.

genImages.description: media comments: how many leading `images` the app generated (the frame, plus the transparent layer in old comments); the rest were pasted. Absent = 2 (old comments). An attachment comment (protocol 17) generates 1 (the marked image).

images.description: attachment ids; labels are assigned at send time

sentIn.description: id of the user message that carried it

voice.description: protocol 14: recordings with their transcripts, at most VOICE_MAX_CLIPS; the batch carries their texts after `text`

IdleCompact.description: `minutes` after the last turn, if the window saw no activity for `awayMinutes`

ImageRef.description: id = sha256 hex (64 chars) of the stored bytes

fields.description: `header`: a short tag over the label; `notes[i]`: the description of `options[i]`; `multi`: several options may be picked (the value is their labels, comma-separated)

tool.description: the tool the ask is for, when the title is not its name; the audit log and the permission event's toolName use it

camera.description: a 3D model comment (protocol 9): the camera the frame was rendered from. A model comment has no `time`.

scale.description: set only when the frame and layer files were downscaled to fit MARK_MAX_BYTES (0 < scale < 1; both files)

time.description: seconds at the pause (video only), ms precision

MediaShape.description: all coordinates are relative to the media's natural size, 0..1

ModelCamera.description: A 3D view's camera (protocol 9): where it is, what it looks at, its vertical field of view in degrees (0 < fov < 180).

ModelOption.description: A model the agent offers. `value` is what is sent back to pick it (an alias such as `sonnet`); `resolved` the full id the agent reports for it once running (`claude-…`), to match the two; `efforts` only for a model that has effort levels.

PageAnchor.description: A place on a rendered HTML page (protocol 13): an element, or an area of an inline SVG. `selector`: the element by its child positions from `body` (an area: its `svg`). `trail`: how it reads, outermost first, the element itself last; also how it is found again when the page changed. `box`: the area in the SVG's own user units (its viewBox). `near`: what an area covers or lies next to.

SlashCommand.description: A slash command or skill the composer's `/` menu offers (already filtered by the server: nothing bound to a terminal). `hint` is the argument hint (`[name]`), `aliases` other names that run it; `builtin`: the agent's own, not the user's or a plugin's.

extra.description: extra usage in this billing period, in minor units of `currency`

StopReason.description: What an agent backend says to the server, whatever agent is behind it (R-M7-13, R-M7-14). Named after ACP's session updates so an ACP adapter is a thin mapping. The Claude mapping lives in server/src/agent/claude/map.ts.

UsageExtra.description: `month`, `limit`: the last reading, for the billing period it was in

extra.description: from the hit to the reset, when the work went on past it

tasks.description: the costliest tasks of the window

from.description: the start of the period; null: all of it

importing.description: the first import is still running: the numbers will grow

weeks.description: every week since the first, idle ones too, whatever the period; `key`: its Monday, YYYY-MM-DD, local time; `hit`: the weekly limit was hit in it; `extra`: the part of `w` on extra usage, when there is one

windows.description: every five-hour window of work, whatever the period, oldest first; `hit`: it ended on a limit hit, and what went past the hit counts in

UsageRow.description: `w`: weighted tokens, the comparison number; `sub`: the part of `w` spent by subagents.

UsageSpend.description: What went on on extra usage. `spent`: minor units of the currency, by the vendor's readings; null: no reading covers it.

UsageTank.description: One weekly limit window: the tokens between its first and last reading, per percent gained.

Voice.description: A stored recording (POST /voice): id = sha256 hex of the WAV, ms = its length, wave = VOICE_BARS bars of 0..31 (loudest = 31).

VoiceClip.description: A recording of a comment with its transcript.

VoiceError.description: Why a voice message has no transcript: Whisper went off, it heard nothing, or it failed.

WireAgentEvent.description: What reaches the clients (R-M7-14): every AgentEvent but the server-internal `init`, `rate-limit` and `commands`.
